notes: TP1 eager, smallest real pilot (task A first case, scaled down). effective_flags_verified=true reflects CLI flags cross-checked against the recovered server_args.py field definitions (exact names/defaults verified), not yet a live /get_server_info read -- that check is done manually immediately after server startup, outside this plan's before/after_measurement hooks (which are POST-only; /get_server_info is GET-only). --skip-server-warmup and SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION=false (added after job 21791's reconciliation) remove two SGLang-internal administrative forwards that otherwise land inside the capture window with no independently-tracked ground truth: (1) SGLang's own built-in engine self-warmup (http_server.py's _wait_and_warmup -> execute_warmup_func, skipped entirely when skip_server_warmup=True, which also flips server_status straight to Up so /health stops 503-ing without waiting on it) and (2) the hidden 1-token generate() that /health performs on every call once the server is otherwise ready (http_server.py's health_generate, gated off for the plain /health path by this env var; confirmed via evidence/approved_image_source/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py and environ.py). Our own requests_tp1_eager_pilot.json warmup-0 request is left in place and is now what absorbs first-dispatch AITER JIT-compile cost instead of SGLang's internal warmup -- that is its intended purpose and it has full independent ground truth via drive_b.py's warmup/requests.json. --selected-regions (added after job 21796's reconciliation) plus marker_runtime.py's roctxProfilerPause/Resume calls (pause at process start, resume on the first measured begin_forward, pause again at confirmed_drain) make rocprofv3 record kernels only inside the measured window -- otherwise weight-loading and first-dispatch JIT-compile kernels dispatched before our own instrumentation starts have no enclosing marker range and show up downstream as unattributed/unexcludable 'unresolved' kernels, which b_check.py's attribution-completeness requirement (every kernel is eager_correlation or excluded, never unresolved) correctly rejects.
